South Korea.title: North Korea Launches ICBM Amid Tensions Over US-South Korea Drill
South Korea.summary: North Korea fired an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) into the Sea of Japan, heightening tensions with the United States and South Korea. The launch comes as the two nations conduct joint military drills. The missile landed approximately 300 miles off the east coast of South Korea.

South Korea.title: US-South Korea to Jointly Develop Hypersonic Missiles
South Korea.summary: The US and South Korea have agreed to jointly develop hypersonic missiles, a move aimed at countering North Korea's growing nuclear capabilities. The development of the missiles will focus on enhancing their speed and accuracy.

South Korea.title: Samsung Electronics' $17 Billion Chip Plant Sparks Environmental Concerns
South Korea.summary: Samsung Electronics' $17 billion chip plant in South Korea's Hwaseong has sparked environmental concerns. The plant's construction has raised concerns about the company's commitment to reducing its environmental impact and protecting the local ecosystem.
